messages:
ana: Quick sync: we need a robust "hotplug" activation for weight variants (no restarts). Goals: atomic switch, safe warmup, easy rollback.

sasha: +1. My take: immutable content-addressed bundle dirs + control-plane activation pointer. Nodes watch pointer and perform local validation before switching.

tony: Filesystem constraints: rename across volumes may not be atomic. Node should do an in-memory pointer swap (RCU) after validating local files.

ana: Can we do progressive per-layer activation so large models can warm up layers incrementally?

sasha: Yes. Manifest can include layer ordering and staged ready flags. Node prefetches layer0..N and flips active pointer once critical layers meet warmup criteria.

rahul: Warmup criteria idea: a combination of prefetch hit ratio + sample inference probes. Config fields: min_prefetch_hit_rate, probe_sample_count, max_warmup_seconds, fallback_hash.

ana: Example manifest fragment: 
```
{ "bundle_hash": "abc123", "layers": [ {"name":"w0","path":"/bundles/abc123/l0","sha256":"...","order":0} ], "warmup": {"min_prefetch_hit_rate":0.7,"probe_sample_count":50,"ttl_seconds":45,"fallback":"prev_hash"} }
```

tony: Loader state machine: IDLE -> VALIDATING (download/verify) -> WARMING -> ACTIVE. Expose lease endpoint to query status and remaining TTL.

sasha: Cache tagging note: tag KV prefix cache entries with bundle_hash so switching variant auto-avoids cross-variant pollution. Prefer tag instead of global invalidate.

rahul: Transcode tradeoff: upload-time transcode simplifies serving & warmup. Lazy on-node transcode allowed for rare variants, but must be async and advertise "not-ready" until complete.

ana: Rollout plan: control-plane activation to small subset (canary) using routing policies, monitor p99 latency, oom events, and sample-quality. Auto-roll back if thresholds hit.

deploy-bot: canary rollout started for bundle abc123 on 2 nodes :rocket:

sasha: Storage layout: /srv/weights/<hash>/layerN.safetensors immutable. GC based on bundle refcounts. Manifest maps logical layers -> file paths + checksums.

tony: Action items: I'll draft a micro-RFC for manifest schema, loader API (activate, status, list-bundles), and a minimal control-plane activation protocol. ETA tomorrow.

ana: Thanks — saving thread as the record for hotplug activation decisions.
